# The Harness Lab — Engineering Foundry (.dev)

> Systems R&D, autonomous verification harnesses, deterministic state machines, exact domain arithmetic, and commit-pinned repository forensics (as of 2026-11-18) engineered by Spencer Teague at The Harness Lab LLC, a Texas limited liability company (`Texas SOS File No. 806765129`, Tom Green County, Texas; engineering foundry at `theharnesslab.dev`, commercial studio at `theharnesslab.com`). Models participate in bounded interpretation; deterministic harness code owns state, authority, isolation, and release proof.

## Canonical Documentation & Monographs

- [Engineering Foundry Home](https://theharnesslab.dev/): Full architecture reference covering Perihelion Loop (`klh` v2.2), Rogue Agents, Agent Browser Hub, Mythos OS, three Texas mineral title examination products (`Title-Desk`, `Title-Desk Agent`, `Artificial Landman`), pure in-browser Effect & Karpathy state-machine teaching laboratories, the 12-tool pinned verification bench, nine engineering field notes, and the 27-build evolution ledger (1,031,828 deduplicated authored LOC across 3,922 commits as of 2026-11-18).
- [Full LLM Technical Reference](https://theharnesslab.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete deep-dive specification of every state machine, sandbox gate, exact rational arithmetic invariant, verification tool, and all 27 verified builds.
- [Landman Title Research Systems Monograph](https://theharnesslab.dev/landman-title-systems/): Source-record provenance, distinct tract vs. instrument identity, cross-platform local OCR in Title-Desk Agent, dual Gemini sessions + exact `BigInt` fraction checks + independent third-provider page-image review, and readback-verified four-sheet draft Excel workbooks.
- [AI Workflow Automation Engineering Monograph](https://theharnesslab.dev/workflow-automation-engineering/): Executable step contracts (`ONE JOB · ONE INPUT · ONE OUTPUT · FAILS AS`), durable revision-pinned state, post-dispatch `UNCERTAIN` receipt reconciliation, prompt-injection fencing, and immutable holdout gates.
- [Custom Business Software Engineering Monograph](https://theharnesslab.dev/business-software-engineering/): Canonical records, default-deny multi-tenant authorization, idempotent webhook/payment boundaries, and 100% client-owned software handover.

## Live Studio & Shipped Platforms

- [Commercial Studio · theharnesslab.com](https://theharnesslab.com/): Client software engineering, autonomous workflow systems, teardowns, and commercial work orders.
- [Title-Desk](https://title-desk.com/): Hosted Texas mineral title examination for independent landmen and abstractors (22,638 hosted LOC, 53 hosted commits, acceptance suite at commit `4bbb3e2`; Texas, one county per run, current mineral interest `MI` owners only). Upload the records for an assignment (upload runs open to everyone; Hybrid and Full record-retrieval runs by invitation only; price prepaid before start, with failed runs returning a run credit) and get a source-linked draft four-sheet ownership workbook with exact fractions, verified by an independent `.xlsx` readback reader and ready for review by a qualified landman or attorney (never a title opinion).
- [Title-Desk Agent](https://desktop.title-desk.com/): The Title-Desk desktop app across Windows, macOS, and Linux (sold and licensed at `desktop.title-desk.com`; 262,305 authored LOC, 1,084 core commits / 1,662 all-branch campaign commits across Aug–Nov 2026, 7,070/7,070 passing engine tests) featuring zero-cost local `tesseract.js` + `@napi-rs/canvas` OCR, landman-authenticated county retrieval across CountyRecords.com, CourthouseDirect, and TexasFile, stated-source-deed book/page lookup, and human-approved conveyance queues.
- [Artificial Landman](https://artificiallandman.io/): Hosted Texas mineral title examination for land teams, brokerages and operators who run many assignments (23,148 hosted LOC, 54 commits, sharing ~16,732 common engine lines with Title-Desk). Artificial Landman runs the same Texas mineral-interest engine as Title-Desk (one county per run, current mineral interest `MI` owners only; draft workbook for review by a qualified landman or attorney), sold and supported on its own.
- [APEX.BUILD](https://apex-build.dev/): Multi-AI cloud IDE and 9-agent software build platform (377,197 authored LOC, 966 main / 1,064 total commits across 5 months).

## Core In-House Engineering Systems

- **Perihelion Loop (`klh` v2.2 · 30,079 LOC · 62 commits):** Transactional Karpathy inner loop (`BASELINE -> PATCH -> UNIT_CHECK -> HOLDOUT_CHECK -> COUNCIL_REVIEW -> KEEP | GIT_RESET_HARD` + append-only `results.tsv`) over a typed outer DAG and fail-closed `cloudroom.dev` Linux VM fabric (`safety.ts`, sorted SHA-256 `transfer.ts` manifests, NFC/symlink quarantine, `null_tested_regression` witnesses, and kernel-isolated `klh forge` lawful no-copy reverse-engineering with `0.00%` shingle/asset overlap).
- **Rogue Agents (22,582 LOC · 103 commits · 730/730 PASS):** Multi-agent command center running Claude, Codex, Antigravity, and Grok as co-leads under quota-governed multi-provider failover, Ollama Cloud subordinate workers, per-job isolated git worktrees, four-agent council endorsement votes, and evidence-bound final reports.
- **Agent Browser Hub (23,406 LOC · 6 commits):** Authenticated MCP multi-agent browser fleet with isolated keyring-backed profiles, warm session pools, live operator watch/pause/takeover/handback controls, and human-owned credential suppression.
- **Mythos OS (28,734 LOC · 62 commits · 17 surfaces):** Studio operating cockpit and 20,911-node persistent structural knowledge graph (`Graphify`) connecting work ledgers, delegation receipts, and cross-workstation autonomy bridges.
- **12-Tool Pinned Verification Bench:** `fast-check`, `StrykerJS`, `ast-grep`, `dependency-cruiser`, `c8`, `Difftastic`, `Toxiproxy`, `Playwright`, `Perfetto`, `DuckDB`, `speedscope`, and `MCP Inspector`.
- **27-Build Evolution Ledger (Jul 2025 – Nov 2026, snapshot as of 2026-11-18):** 27 verified builds, 1,031,828 deduplicated authored source lines (excluding `node_modules`, lockfiles, generated/vendored artifacts, and binaries), and 3,922 commits engineered in parallel (peak: 9 concurrent builds in flight in August 2026).
